cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've booked your car into that garage with the café. Shall we have breakfast there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Their full breakfast includes unlimited toast. You always say that's important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's take the bus. Then we can both have the breakfast cocktails.

mechanism: A uses supposedly expert vehicle-intake procedure to prevent B asking what happened to B car, correcting B investigative wording instead of discussing damage.
confusable: Helpful diagnosis would welcome the symptom and cause; this A repeatedly replaces that subject with the proper process.
comparison: The rent alternative diverts through competent curtain installation rather than garage intake terminology.
seedUse: Garage and unexplained car booking come from D14-a; S03 adds substantive procedural corrections instead of breakfast as unrelated distraction.
